title: Byrne Professor of Administrative Law, Emeritus
bio: Todd Rakoff graduated from Harvard Law School in 1975, and joined the faculty in 1979 after clerking for Hon. Henry Friendly and practicing with Foley, Hoag and Eliot in Boston. He teaches contracts and administrative law, has been Dean of the J.D. Program, and is presently the Byrne Professor of Administrative Law. Since the mid-1980s […]
